description: GTFS - Transport - horaires des lignes de la communauté de communes Corse du Sud A BERLINA is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. Vous trouverez dans ce jeu de données un export du réseau de transport des cars pour A BERLINA en Corse au format standard GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification), comportant neuf fichiers (agency, calendar, calendardates, routes, shapes, stoptimes, stops, trips). En plus de la fourniture d'un format GTFS ainsi qu'un format alternatif GeoJSON est proposé. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Transport & Mobility. Its keywords are transport urbain, transport, car, horaire, GTFS, netex. The portal shows 3 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
